name: @vellumai/windows
description: Electron wrapper for the Vellum Assistant Windows app.

scripts.dev:standalone: bun run install:all && concurrently --kill-others --names web,electron --prefix-colors blue,green "bun run dev:web" "bun run dev:electron"
scripts.install:all: bun install && bun run setup && bun run build:native-helper
scripts.test:ci: bun run --filter=@vellumai/electron-desktop test && bun run --filter=@vellumai/native-sidecar test && bun scripts/run-tests.ts && bun scripts/build-native-helper.ts --check && bun scripts/build-preview-handler.ts --test-architecture && bun scripts/build-preview-handler.ts --native-test
scripts.build:web: cd ../web && bun install && bun run openapi-ts && bun run build && cd ../windows && mkdir -p resources && rm -rf resources/web-dist && cp -R ../web/dist resources/web-dist
scripts.pack: bun run build:runtime && bun run build:native-helper && bun run build && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never
